input:
The value of alpha, so that the volume of the parallelepiped formed by i + alpha j + k, j + alpha k and alpha i + k becomes maximum, is

Options:
A. -1/sqrt(3)
B. 1/sqrt(3)
C. -sqrt(3)
D. sqrt(3)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find alpha that maximizes the scalar triple product expression used for volume in the given solution.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Volume expression comes from determinant of the three vectors.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Compute determinant, differentiate, find critical points, apply second derivative test.
logical_steps: Step 4: Use d2V/dalpha2 at critical points

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Second derivative is negative at alpha = -1/sqrt(3), giving the required maximum in the provided method.
